description:
In an upcoming interview with the BBC, the late Princess Diana’s brother repeats his claim that then Prince Charles told him the Royal family would “forget her soon enough.” 

Buckingham Palace responded to the comments, published before the interview, by saying: "His Majesty is mindful that the pain of fraternal grief can cloud reason, affect judgement and colour memory in ways others do not recognise, even many years after such a loss."
title: Princess Diana's brother defends claims about King Charles to BBC
